UPDATED ON: 2026-09-03


Please look through guide full from the top to the bottom before beginning to do anything.
Beware! This guide is intended for experienced users and not half-baked newbies.

To provide context, I will first outline my hardware requirements, inspired by a suggestion from [Rerdavies] on [HackerNews] .

My cell reqs: gsm calls, sms, BT speakers, navigation, camera app, web surfing, a bit of social media.
Additionally, for optimal convenience and ergonomics, I advise following this guide on a desktop or laptop rather than mobile phone.

Initially, I planned to stop updating Android at the end of 2026, following the [KeepAndroidOpen] initiative.
However, once I found out that Android 17 would be released for the Xiaomi 15 Ultra on August 27,
I immediately decided to freeze my installation on Android 16.
Stupid dumb asses > as if HyperOS 3 wasn’t already shitty enough.

In this comprehensive guide, we will maximize what this device can do without rooting.
We are locking the operating system to the final version of Android 16 and skipping Android 17 entirely.
Doin’ so because version 17 brings too many nasty things to the table, and we all want to avoid them.
More telemetry, more rights to them, less to user, more AI slop, more unswitchable services.

Also, i’ll not post many pictures to keep post clean and compact in size.

░▒▓█ FACTORY RESET

Of course you should backup your all data first at the very begging of the procedure.
By the way, i am not taking any responsibility if you brick your phone or render your data to an unusable state.
Information here is strictly mirrors my personal experience. Take the pill only as a reference.

Settings -> My device -> Factory reset -> Erase all data

░▒▓█ INSTALLATION FROM SCRATCH

In this section i’ll guide you through the first kickstart of your device and describe every single setting
related to user privacy, this is the most complete guide on the old interwebs.

During installation decline following settings.

BASIC SETTINGS

Location -> OFF
Emergency location -> OFF
Automatic system updates -> OFF
Send usage and diagnostic data -> OFF
User experience program -> OFF
Child mode -> OFF

Set screen lock -> Skip [we'll set pattern swipe later]

System navigation mode -> Buttons [to keep it oldschool]

We can use [Nova Launcher] for even more advanced gestures stuff,
way cooler interfact than internal Android 16 implementation can provide

░▒▓█ UPDATE DEVICE FIRMWARE

Update to the latest HyperOS version because it brings important camera application improvements,
like remembering last used resolution any picture format.
Exact version number: 3.0.309.0.WOACNXM.C11. As August 2026 it is the last Android 16 based version of hyperOS.

Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> Install automatically -> NO
Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Automatic updates -> OFF
Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Download using mobile data -> OFF

Reboot device. Also you should update Bluetooth module and Battery firmware in appropriate sections.
Modern Bluetooth implementation in HyperOS is highly unreliable and renders difficulties when pairing with older Android 11 devices.

Keep in mind that: after each update almost all custom permissions are wiped out, why? because it is a dog turd.

░▒▓█ REMOVE CHINESE BLOATWARE

Important note before we start, if you can’t find certain option, try to search it in the settings search bar.
Tool can help find settings that are not even in GUI! So remember that.

Second, not the main screen, can be uninstalled completely.
Leave in peace only Security with green lightning shield on it.
We’ll deal with it later.

Embedded Browser is a good example on how to deal with bloated applications [blue globe icon].
I prefer to use privacy focused Firefox forks, so we don’t need bloated chrome-based cr#p.
FORCE IT TO STOP.

App info -> Storage -> Clear data -> Clear cache
App info -> Network access -> turn off Mobile data / WLAN / Background data
[Take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI]
App info -> Power - Battery details -> Battery saver -> Restrict background apps
App info -> Permissions -> Autostart -> OFF
App info -> Permissions -> Permissions -> OFF
[Watch out for the nestedness, turn off all settings and even sub settings, take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI]

░▒▓█ UPDATE CAMERA MODULE

On the first screen we need only GetApps application to update Camera and then you can restrict it as a Browser we did earlier.
Upon first start untick checkbox Update over WLAN and agree to proceed.
In a couple of time application will push refused suggestion again, so repeat denial.
Right after that there will be another attempt to push loads of shit to your device
[They call it “essential apps”, reject it with a force.
After updating camera application remove ALL possible permissions from GetApps bloatfest abomination,
especially restrict access to the list of installed applications.

░▒▓█ TURN OFF ADS AND USAGE TELEMETRY 

Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Ad services -> Personalized ad recommendations -> OFF
Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Enroll in User experience program -> OFF
Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Usage and diagnostics -> OFF

Important: type in settings search Ads and select Manage system ads > Ads in system apps > OFF

Some words about Virtual ID, it is almost placebo “privacy” feature introduced by Xiaomi.
It has little to no use in terms of real privacy, so it is up to you to use or not.

Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Virtual ID

You can reset virtual ID, right after you install all needed software.

░▒▓█ TURN OFF FAKE MEMORY EXTENDER

Do this to get rid of stutters and micro freezes.

Settings -> Additional settings -> Memory extension -> OFF

Reboot the device for a refresh.

Ok back to those green shield (shit). In settings:

Online services -> OFF
Privacy -> Personalized recommendations -> OFF
Privacy -> Withdrawal of consent -> OFF

Take away all possible permissions and notifications, because it is super annoying thing.
As for me i just “uninstalled” that sucker. But it can’t be fully uninstalled since we don’t have root.
More over this shit will try to restore it in a while, so pay attention.

░▒▓█ TUNING PLAY STORE

[Install F-Droid] to get the reliable source of free applications.

Get rid of embedded bloated Chinese keyboard and replace it with [Unexpected Keyboard] .
Make sure to turn off native keyboards Baido IME and Sogou IME, they can be found in.

Settings -> Additional settings -> Languages & input -> Manage keyboards

Before diving into deeper bloatware cleansing process i have to mention that i prefer to use not only third-party repository,
but custom applications too. Application launcher, secure keyboard, weather prediction and so on and so forth. Also i do not use car.

If you need Google services, turn on Basic Google services:

You can install latest Google Play from the [APkpure] if you want to be “UP-TO-DATE”.

░▒▓█ OVERCOME SHIT STORM OF BLOATWARE PISS

In this part we will tune system to our own preferences
and continue to fight with pre-installed bloatware.

When you try to install any application from [F-Droid] you will be faced this hieroglyphs.

Select right button to proceed. Later we’ll deal with it harshly.
Right after that system spits at you with next vomit like this.
Reject with a force.

System will try to install Security green shield when you enter installed Apps menu.
Reject the action.

Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Show all apps
This is the place for all your apps to handle.

Settings -> Apps -> Autostart
Set to autostart here your Launcher, keyboard and camera application.
Remember that three dots holds Show system apps.
Remove all cr#p like AI and hieroglyphic applications to speed up system boot.

Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Notify about updates -> OFF
Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Recommendations -> OFF
Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Smart app assistant -> Notify about errors -> OFF [We'll blast it later in the guide]

Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Default apps
[Set your defaults for applications]

If you are installing third party launcher make sure to restrict System Launcher as much as possible.
You will be shown a scary red danger sign with red buttons. Third party is way good especially abandoned ones.

Don’t forget to take away Mobile data and Background data permissions from Package installer,
just to minimize network queries, although WiFi traffic can’t be turned of from GUI.

You can lock applications in recent list by swiping from top to the bottom in the recent applications gallery you will see a little lock next to application name if it is protected.

░▒▓█ RESTRICTING NETWORK ACCESS

Provided settings not only improve your online privacy, but also will substantially decrease power consumption of the device.

You may want to leave Improve Location Accuracy turned on for better positioning.

Here you can setup applications which can access your location: compass, map or any other service you want.

Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> ...

In some cases where it is hard to find certain option in the marasmic jungle of settings it is easier to use search function.
Type in settings search “network access” and select it.

Security -> Data usage -> Network access -> Mobile data
Security -> Data usage -> Network access -> WLAN

Take a note that at the bottom of the page in Mobile data category there is System apps section.

Moreover there is setting for newly installed applications.
In the Network access menu tap three dots and select New apps default settings.
For new software I prefer to keep Mobile data and WLAN turned off.

In three dots menu also there is Background connection.
You can replicated above mentioned restrictions to this menu too.
Also you have option to unrestricted certain applications in terms of mobile traffic.

Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Other permissions -> Special permissions -> Unrestricted mobile access

To see all applications including system ones, tap three dots menu and select Show system.

░▒▓█ CHECKING YOUR APPS FOR PRIVACY TRACKERS

There is an excellent privacy application [Exodus] .
It check how deeply your applications invade into the system core.
Software which marked by red color request too many permissions.
You should check this category manually and restrict invasive applications with a brute force.

░▒▓█ SIDE-LOADING THIRD PARTY APPLICATIONS

When logging to Xiaomi account [essential for USB/Wifi debugging to sideload needed apps and freeze bloat sh@t]
deny MiCloud integration for your own good and do not update account application.

To be able to install software with minimal restriction you have to turn on Developer mode.

Settings -> My device -> tap multiple times in a row on OS version.

After above mentioned action hidden settings appear at this location.

Settings -> Additional settings -> Developer options

Here we’ll turn off telemetry stuff and improve system performance a bit.
If value do not mentioned here leave it at it’s defaults.

Enable Bluetooth stack log -> Error
Bluetooth HCI snoop log -> Disabled
Automatic system updates -> OFF

Since i constantly mess around with the device debugging options should be enabled.
Turn on wireless debugging only when you try to execute ADB commands in [aShell] .
Logger buffer size set 8 MB because not all logs can be turned off and bigger buffer give a performance boost in logging operations.

Debugging -> USB debugging -> ON
Debugging -> Wireless debugging -> ON 
Debugging -> Install via USB -> ON
Debugging -> USB debugging (security settings) -> ON
Debugging -> Disable ADB authorization timeout -> ON
Debugging -> Verify apps over USB -> OFF
Debugging -> Verify bytecode of debuggable apps -> OFF
Debugging -> Logger buffer sizes -> 8 MB
Debugging -> Select log level -> OFF

Networking related stuff to be tweaked. HD audio can be set to ON only if hardware supports it.

Networking -> Enable Wi-Fi verbose logging -> OFF
Networking -> Wi-Fi scan throttling -> ON
Networking -> Tethering hardware acceleration -> ON
Networking -> Default USB configuration -> File transfer
Networking -> High speed Bluetooth transfers -> ON
Networking -> Enable Bluetooth page scan -> ON
Networking -> Bluetooth AVRCP version -> AVRCP 1.6
Networking -> Bluetooth MAP version -> AVRCP 1.4
Networking -> HD audio -> ON

Networking -> NFC NCI unfiltered log -> OFF

Input -> Show taps -> ON

To decrease CPU load do this.

Drawing -> Windows animation scale -> 0.5x
Drawing -> Transition animation scale -> 0.5x
Drawing -> Animation duration scale -> 0.5x

First one is important for compatibility with some applications. Second one gives a very little performance gain.

Window management -> Force activities to be resizable -> ON
App cache optimization -> ON

░▒▓█ RESTORING REMOVED PERMISSIONS

Sometimes invasive and annoying HyperOS so-called “protection” removes needed permissions of your third-party apps.
If some application begins to show signs of incorrect working restore it’s permissions.

Settings -> Apps -> Manage permissions -> ... -> Unblock permissions

Ok, the most basic part is done and now to the even more deeper things.

░▒▓█ ADVANCED MANUAL DEBLOATING VIA ADB INTERFACE

In this section we won’t even touch desktop machines, everything will be made directly on the phone.
A bit tedious, although no computer is required.
But will have to do this in any case, since it is a comprehensive guide for God’s sake.
Take a note that there you will only remove unneeded crap, but not tune the system.

  • [F-Droid] [open-source app-store, like better alternative to Google store]
  • [Shizuku] [giving you ability to run ADB commands without connecting device to the computer, science happens via WiFi]
  • [aShell] [console for running ADB commands, which is running on top of the Shizuku]

You have to turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options,
for this you will need active and logged in Xiaomi account.

Settings -> Additional settings -> Developer options -> Wireless debugging -> ON
  • start Shizuku
  • select Start, application suggests you to proceed to pairing step
  • enable Android notifications
Settings -> Notifications & status bar -> Notification style -> Notification shade -> Android

This setting is essential or otherwise you won’t get pairing notifications in pairing process
Sometimes you have to reboot to make thing rollin'.

  • again visit Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code
  • enter provided code in the notification area in the top system curtain
  • return to Shizuku and confirm that “Shizuku is running” appeared in the main screen of the application

Now you can safely open ADB shell to execute various commands,
for these purposes i am using aShell software,yours may vary.

like removing broadcast services and Qualcomm stuff, so quite safe to use.

This guide is intended for experienced users and not half-baked newbies. To provide context, I will first outline my hardware requirements, inspired by a suggestion from [Rerdavies] on [HackerNews] . My cell reqs: gsm calls, sms, BT speakers, navigation, camera app, web surfing, a bit of social media. Additionally, for optimal convenience and ergonomics, I advise following this guide on a desktop or laptop rather than mobile phone. Initially, I planned to stop updating Android at the end of 2026, following the [KeepAndroidOpen] initiative. However, once I found out that Android 17 would be released for the Xiaomi 15 Ultra on August 27, I immediately decided to freeze my installation on Android 16. Stupid dumb asses > as if HyperOS 3 wasn’t already shitty enough. In this comprehensive guide, we will maximize what this device can do without rooting. We are locking the operating system to the final version of Android 16 and skipping Android 17 entirely. Doin’ so because version 17 brings too many nasty things to the table, and we all want to avoid them. More telemetry, more rights to them, less to user, more AI slop, more unswitchable services. Also, i’ll not post many pictures to keep post clean and compact in size. ░▒▓█ FACTORY RESET Of course you should backup your all data first at the very begging of the procedure. By the way, i am not taking any responsibility if you brick your phone or render your data to an unusable state. Information here is strictly mirrors my personal experience. Take the pill only as a reference. Settings -> My device -> Factory reset -> Erase all data ░▒▓█ INSTALLATION FROM SCRATCH In this section i’ll guide you through the first kickstart of your device and describe every single setting related to user privacy, this is the most complete guide on the old interwebs. During installation decline following settings. BASIC SETTINGS Location -> OFF Emergency location -> OFF Automatic system updates -> OFF Send usage and diagnostic data -> OFF User experience program -> OFF Child mode -> OFF Interconnection -> OFF EXTENSION SERVICES Browser -> OFF Caller ID -> OFF Content Center -> OFF Duokan -> OFF Mi video -> OFF Search -> OFF Super Mi AI -> OFF Wallet -> OFF Xiaomi account -> OFF Xiaomi home -> OFF Xiaomi hyper AI engine -> OFF Xiaomi share -> OFF Set screen lock -> Skip [we'll set pattern swipe later] System navigation mode -> Buttons [to keep it oldschool] We can use [Nova Launcher] for even more advanced gestures stuff, way cooler interfact than internal Android 16 implementation can provide ░▒▓█ UPDATE DEVICE FIRMWARE Update to the latest HyperOS version because it brings important camera application improvements, like remembering last used resolution any picture format. Exact version number: 3.0.309.0.WOACNXM.C11. As August 2026 it is the last Android 16 based version of hyperOS. Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> Install automatically -> NO Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Automatic updates -> OFF Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Download using mobile data -> OFF Reboot device. Also you should update Bluetooth module and Battery firmware in appropriate sections. Modern Bluetooth implementation in HyperOS is highly unreliable and renders difficulties when pairing with older Android 11 devices. Keep in mind that: after each update almost all custom permissions are wiped out, why? because it is a dog turd. ░▒▓█ REMOVE CHINESE BLOATWARE Important note before we start, if you can’t find certain option, try to search it in the settings search bar. Tool can help find settings that are not even in GUI! So remember that. Second, not the main screen, can be uninstalled completely. Leave in peace only Security with green lightning shield on it. We’ll deal with it later. Embedded Browser is a good example on how to deal with bloated applications [blue globe icon]. I prefer to use privacy focused Firefox forks, so we don’t need bloated chrome-based cr#p. FORCE IT TO STOP. App info -> Force stop App info -> Storage -> Clear data -> Clear cache App info -> Network access -> turn off Mobile data / WLAN / Background data [Take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI] App info -> Power - Battery details -> Battery saver -> Restrict background apps App info -> Permissions -> Autostart -> OFF App info -> Permissions -> Permissions -> OFF [Watch out for the nestedness, turn off all settings and even sub settings, take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI] Here is a complete list of all possible permissions for Android 16 device. Location Access camera Microphone Photos and videos Music and audio Messages Contacts Nearby devices Other permissions Send MMS messages Read SMS and MMS Receive SMS and MMS Read your contacts Access items in the clipboard Save items to clipboard Access device motion and orientation Access list of installed apps Adjust media volume Home screen shortcuts Service SMS Show on Lock screen Open new windows while running in the background Display pop-up windows Dynamic wallpaper services Manage chain start Turn off damn notifications! App info - Permissions - Notifications - OFF ░▒▓█ UPDATE CAMERA MODULE On the first screen we need only GetApps application to update Camera and then you can restrict it as a Browser we did earlier. Upon first start untick checkbox Update over WLAN and agree to proceed. In a couple of time application will push refused suggestion again, so repeat denial. Right after that there will be another attempt to push loads of shit to your device [They call it “essential apps”, reject it with a force. After updating camera application remove ALL possible permissions from GetApps bloatfest abomination, especially restrict access to the list of installed applications. ░▒▓█ TURN OFF ADS AND USAGE TELEMETRY Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Ad services -> Personalized ad recommendations -> OFF Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Enroll in User experience program -> OFF Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Usage and diagnostics -> OFF Important: type in settings search Ads and select Manage system ads > Ads in system apps > OFF Some words about Virtual ID, it is almost placebo “privacy” feature introduced by Xiaomi. It has little to no use in terms of real privacy, so it is up to you to use or not. Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Virtual ID You can reset virtual ID, right after you install all needed software. ░▒▓█ TURN OFF FAKE MEMORY EXTENDER Do this to get rid of stutters and micro freezes. Settings -> Additional settings -> Memory extension -> OFF Reboot the device for a refresh. ░▒▓█ SECURITY APPLICATION Ok back to those green shield (shit). In settings: Allow to connect to the internet and access location -> OFF Online services -> OFF Privacy -> Personalized recommendations -> OFF Privacy -> Withdrawal of consent -> OFF Take away all possible permissions and notifications, because it is super annoying thing. As for me i just “uninstalled” that sucker. But it can’t be fully uninstalled since we don’t have root. More over this shit will try to restore it in a while, so pay attention. ░▒▓█ TUNING PLAY STORE Bring on some little tweaks to Play Store as well. Settings -> General -> Use device location -> OFF Settings -> General -> App install optimization -> OFF Settings -> Network preferences -> App download preference -> Ask me every time Settings -> Family -> Content restrictions -> OFF Play Protect -> OFF Play Protect -> Top Gear -> Play Protect settings -> Scan apps with Play Protect -> OFF Play Protect -> Top Gear -> Play Protect settings -> Improve harmful app detection -> OFF ░▒▓█ DEPLOY F-DROID REPOSITORY [Install F-Droid] to get the reliable source of free applications. Get rid of embedded bloated Chinese keyboard and replace it with [Unexpected Keyboard] . Make sure to turn off native keyboards Baido IME and Sogou IME, they can be found in. Settings -> Additional settings -> Languages & input -> Manage keyboards Before diving into deeper bloatware cleansing process i have to mention that i prefer to use not only third-party repository, but custom applications too. Application launcher, secure keyboard, weather prediction and so on and so forth. Also i do not use car. ░▒▓█ UNINSTALLING BLOATWARE List of crap that you don’t need. Limit permissions and notifications, restrict network where possible to the following things. All hieroglyphic stuff Ad privacy AI Call Assistant AI Service All hieroglyphic stuff Baidu IME for Xiaomi CarWith Cleaner Content center Family guard Find device Gallery editor iFlytek IME for Xiaomi Mi AI speech engine Mi Doc Viewer Mi Drive MI FIDO Mi Game AI Service Mi Wallpaper carousel MiMacro MiStore system components MiWallpaper Package installer Screen recorder Screenshot Search Smart cards Web extension Sogou IME for Xiaomi System launcher Talpus Translate Updater XiaoaiRecommendation Xiaomi account Xiaomi Cloud Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi Xiaomi HyperAI engine Xiaomi service framework Xiaomi Share Xiaomi SIM Activation Service You will need XiaomiAccount for enabling USB/Wifi debugging, after you are done with tuneup you can safely restrict this process and it’s permissions. Advanced users can find the method to freeze these applications using the ADB shell below! More automatic stuff to turn off. Quick apps service framework -> Performance optimization -> Preload pages -> OFF Quick apps service framework -> Performance optimization -> Update automatically -> OFF ░▒▓█ DEFAULTS FOR EMBEDDED APPLICATIONS Here you can setup default apps, all in one place Settings -> Apps -> ... Other settings -> System app settings As far as i remember correctly there should be some bloat in Messaging application. GetApps and Search is infested also. GETAPPS Preload gaming resources when connected to WLAN -> OFF Privacy -> Personalized services -> OFF Privacy -> Withdrawal of consent -> Agree Privacy -> Manage permissions -> Access the list of apps installed on this device -> block ALL Privacy -> Manage permissions -> Access calendar events -> block ALL Privacy -> Manage permissions -> Collect device identifier IMSI -> OFF Privacy -> Manage permissions -> Additional features -> turn down ALL About -> Update GetApps automatically -> OFF Notifications -> Turn OFF everything As for me, it is better to cancel this service at all since we already acquired needed camera update, everything else is unneeded. SEARCH Permissions -> Access contacts -> OFF Security alerts -> OFF Ad filter -> OFF About global search -> Withdrawal of consent -> ON About global search -> Personalized content recommendations -> OFF Personalized ads -> OFF ░▒▓█ ENABLING AND UPDATING GOOGLE SERVICES If you need Google services, turn on Basic Google services: Settings -> Additional settings -> Accounts & sync -> Basic Google Services -> ON You can install latest Google Play from the [APkpure] if you want to be “UP-TO-DATE”. ░▒▓█ OVERCOME SHIT STORM OF BLOATWARE PISS In this part we will tune system to our own preferences and continue to fight with pre-installed bloatware. When you try to install any application from [F-Droid] you will be faced this hieroglyphs. Select right button to proceed. Later we’ll deal with it harshly. Right after that system spits at you with next vomit like this. Reject with a force. System will try to install Security green shield when you enter installed Apps menu. Reject the action. Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Show all apps This is the place for all your apps to handle. Settings -> Apps -> Autostart Set to autostart here your Launcher, keyboard and camera application. Remember that three dots holds Show system apps. Remove all cr#p like AI and hieroglyphic applications to speed up system boot. Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Notify about updates -> OFF Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Recommendations -> OFF Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Smart app assistant -> Notify about errors -> OFF [We'll blast it later in the guide] Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Default apps [Set your defaults for applications] If you are installing third party launcher make sure to restrict System Launcher as much as possible. You will be shown a scary red danger sign with red buttons. Third party is way good especially abandoned ones. Don’t forget to take away Mobile data and Background data permissions from Package installer, just to minimize network queries, although WiFi traffic can’t be turned of from GUI. You can lock applications in recent list by swiping from top to the bottom in the recent applications gallery you will see a little lock next to application name if it is protected. Settings -> Notifications & status bar -> Smart devices control -> None Last, but surely not least setting where you can setup important permissions, that is why this setting buried under loads of rhinoceros sh@t. Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Other permissions -> Special permissions Here is the list of all settings available. You can spend hours here fine-tuning required or non-needed applications. All files access Device admin Display over other apps Modes access Media management apps Modify system settings Notification read, reply & control Change media output Picture-in-picture Premium SMS Unrestricted mobile data Install unknown apps Alarms & reminders App usage data VR helper services WLAN control Screen turn-on control Full screen notifications Write system preferences Launch via NFC Settings -> Accessibility -> General -> Downloaded apps Disable all available options here including hieroglyphic ones. Baidu IME for Xiaomi General authorization Screenshot Sogou IME for Xiaomi Xiaomi HyperAI engine More bloat to turn off. Settings -> Additional settings -> Additional app features -> Healthy device usage Disable all available options here. Backup and restore CarWith Device activation Enterprise mode Feedback Healthy device usage Mi Coins Mi Protect Security - Find Device Wallet Xiaomi Cloud Xiaomi HyperAI Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Default apps -> Assist & voice input -> Digital assistant app -> none Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Notify about updates -> OFF Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Other settings -> Recommendations -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security -> Anti-fraud protection Calls/Messages/Apps/Casting -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security -> Alerts for smart home devices -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Find Hub -> OFF When you start Messaging (SMS) for the first time deny Mi message and Smart messaging. In settings select Privacy policy and untoggle both Withdraw consent options. ░▒▓█ RESTRICTING NETWORK ACCESS Provided settings not only improve your online privacy, but also will substantially decrease power consumption of the device. Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> Location -> Use location services -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> Location -> Location services -> Emergency Location Service -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> Location -> Location services -> Improve Location Accuracy -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> Location -> Location services -> WLAN scanning -> OFF Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> Location -> Location services -> Bluetooth scanning -> OFF You may want to leave Improve Location Accuracy turned on for better positioning. Here you can setup applications which can access your location: compass, map or any other service you want. Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Location -> ... In some cases where it is hard to find certain option in the marasmic jungle of settings it is easier to use search function. Type in settings search “network access” and select it. Security -> Data usage -> Network access -> Mobile data Security -> Data usage -> Network access -> WLAN Take a note that at the bottom of the page in Mobile data category there is System apps section. Moreover there is setting for newly installed applications. In the Network access menu tap three dots and select New apps default settings. For new software I prefer to keep Mobile data and WLAN turned off. In three dots menu also there is Background connection. You can replicated above mentioned restrictions to this menu too. Also you have option to unrestricted certain applications in terms of mobile traffic. Settings -> Privacy & security -> Privacy -> Other permissions -> Special permissions -> Unrestricted mobile access To see all applications including system ones, tap three dots menu and select Show system. ░▒▓█ CHECKING YOUR APPS FOR PRIVACY TRACKERS There is an excellent privacy application [Exodus] . It check how deeply your applications invade into the system core. Software which marked by red color request too many permissions. You should check this category manually and restrict invasive applications with a brute force. ░▒▓█ SIDE-LOADING THIRD PARTY APPLICATIONS When logging to Xiaomi account [essential for USB/Wifi debugging to sideload needed apps and freeze bloat sh@t] deny MiCloud integration for your own good and do not update account application. To be able to install software with minimal restriction you have to turn on Developer mode. Settings -> My device -> tap multiple times in a row on OS version. After above mentioned action hidden settings appear at this location. Settings -> Additional settings -> Developer options Here we’ll turn off telemetry stuff and improve system performance a bit. If value do not mentioned here leave it at it’s defaults. Enable Bluetooth stack log -> Error Bluetooth HCI snoop log -> Disabled Automatic system updates -> OFF Since i constantly mess around with the device debugging options should be enabled. Turn on wireless debugging only when you try to execute ADB commands in [aShell] . Logger buffer size set 8 MB because not all logs can be turned off and bigger buffer give a performance boost in logging operations. Debugging -> USB debugging -> ON Debugging -> Wireless debugging -> ON Debugging -> Install via USB -> ON Debugging -> USB debugging (security settings) -> ON Debugging -> Disable ADB authorization timeout -> ON Debugging -> Verify apps over USB -> OFF Debugging -> Verify bytecode of debuggable apps -> OFF Debugging -> Logger buffer sizes -> 8 MB Debugging -> Select log level -> OFF Networking related stuff to be tweaked. HD audio can be set to ON only if hardware supports it. Networking -> Enable Wi-Fi verbose logging -> OFF Networking -> Wi-Fi scan throttling -> ON Networking -> Tethering hardware acceleration -> ON Networking -> Default USB configuration -> File transfer Networking -> High speed Bluetooth transfers -> ON Networking -> Enable Bluetooth page scan -> ON Networking -> Bluetooth AVRCP version -> AVRCP 1.6 Networking -> Bluetooth MAP version -> AVRCP 1.4 Networking -> HD audio -> ON Networking -> NFC verbose vendor debug log -> OFF Networking -> NFC NCI unfiltered log -> OFF Just to see taps visually is more convenient for me. Input -> Show taps -> ON To decrease CPU load do this. Drawing -> Windows animation scale -> 0.5x Drawing -> Transition animation scale -> 0.5x Drawing -> Animation duration scale -> 0.5x First one is important for compatibility with some applications. Second one gives a very little performance gain. Window management -> Force activities to be resizable -> ON App cache optimization -> ON ░▒▓█ RESTORING REMOVED PERMISSIONS Sometimes invasive and annoying HyperOS so-called “protection” removes needed permissions of your third-party apps. If some application begins to show signs of incorrect working restore it’s permissions. Settings -> Apps -> Manage permissions -> ... -> Unblock permissions Ok, the most basic part is done and now to the even more deeper things. ░▒▓█ ADVANCED MANUAL DEBLOATING VIA ADB INTERFACE In this section we won’t even touch desktop machines, everything will be made directly on the phone. A bit tedious, although no computer is required. But will have to do this in any case, since it is a comprehensive guide for God’s sake. Take a note that there you will only remove unneeded crap, but not tune the system. [F-Droid] [open-source app-store, like better alternative to Google store] [Shizuku] [giving you ability to run ADB commands without connecting device to the computer, science happens via WiFi] [aShell] [console for running ADB commands, which is running on top of the Shizuku] You have to turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options, for this you will need active and logged in Xiaomi account. Settings -> Additional settings -> Developer options -> Wireless debugging -> ON start Shizuku select Start, application suggests you to proceed to pairing step enable Android notifications Settings -> Notifications & status bar -> Notification style -> Notification shade -> Android This setting is essential or otherwise you won’t get pairing notifications in pairing process Sometimes you have to reboot to make thing rollin'. again visit Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code enter provided code in the notification area in the top system curtain return to Shizuku and confirm that “Shizuku is running” appeared in the main screen of the application Now you can safely open ADB shell to execute various commands, for these purposes i am using aShell software,yours may vary. UPDATED ON: 2026-09-03

Please look through guide full from the top to the bottom before beginning to do anything. Beware! This guide is intended for experienced users and not half-baked newbies.
To provide context, I will first outline my hardware requirements, inspired by a suggestion from [Rerdavies] on [HackerNews] .

My cell reqs: gsm calls, sms, BT speakers, navigation, camera app, web surfing, a bit of social media. Additionally, for optimal convenience and ergonomics, I advise following this guide on a desktop or laptop rather than mobile phone.

Initially, I planned to stop updating Android at the end of 2026, following the [KeepAndroidOpen] initiative. However, once I found out that Android 17 would be released for the Xiaomi 15 Ultra on August 27, I immediately decided to freeze my installation on Android 16. Stupid dumb asses > as if HyperOS 3 wasn’t already shitty enough.

In this comprehensive guide, we will maximize what this device can do without rooting. We are locking the operating system to the final version of Android 16 and skipping Android 17 entirely. Doin’ so because version 17 brings too many nasty things to the table, and we all want to avoid them. More telemetry, more rights to them, less to user, more AI slop, more unswitchable services.

Also, i’ll not post many pictures to keep post clean and compact in size.

░▒▓█ FACTORY RESET

Of course you should backup your all data first at the very begging of the procedure. By the way, i am not taking any responsibility if you brick your phone or render your data to an unusable state. Information here is strictly mirrors my personal experience. Take the pill only as a reference.

Settings -> My device -> Factory reset -> Erase all data

░▒▓█ INSTALLATION FROM SCRATCH

In this section i’ll guide you through the first kickstart of your device and describe every single setting related to user privacy, this is the most complete guide on the old interwebs.

During installation decline following settings.

BASIC SETTINGS

Location -> OFF
Emergency location -> OFF
Automatic system updates -> OFF

Child mode -> OFF
Interconnection -> OFF

EXTENSION SERVICES

Browser -> OFF
Caller ID -> OFF

Duokan -> OFF
Mi video -> OFF
Search -> OFF
Super Mi AI -> OFF
Wallet -> OFF
Xiaomi account -> OFF
Xiaomi home -> OFF
Xiaomi hyper AI engine -> OFF
Xiaomi share -> OFF

Set screen lock -> Skip [we'll set pattern swipe later]

System navigation mode -> Buttons [to keep it oldschool]

We can use [Nova Launcher] for even more advanced gestures stuff, way cooler interfact than internal Android 16 implementation can provide

░▒▓█ UPDATE DEVICE FIRMWARE

Update to the latest HyperOS version because it brings important camera application improvements, like remembering last used resolution any picture format. Exact version number: 3.0.309.0.WOACNXM.C11. As August 2026 it is the last Android 16 based version of hyperOS.

Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> Install automatically -> NO
Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Automatic updates -> OFF
Settings -> My device -> Tap on Xiaomi hyperos logo -> ... -> Download using mobile data -> OFF

Reboot device. Also you should update Bluetooth module and Battery firmware in appropriate sections. Modern Bluetooth implementation in HyperOS is highly unreliable and renders difficulties when pairing with older Android 11 devices.

Keep in mind that: after each update almost all custom permissions are wiped out, why? because it is a dog turd.

░▒▓█ REMOVE CHINESE BLOATWARE

Important note before we start, if you can’t find certain option, try to search it in the settings search bar. Tool can help find settings that are not even in GUI! So remember that.

Second, not the main screen, can be uninstalled completely. Leave in peace only Security with green lightning shield on it. We’ll deal with it later.

Embedded Browser is a good example on how to deal with bloated applications [blue globe icon]. I prefer to use privacy focused Firefox forks, so we don’t need bloated chrome-based cr#p. FORCE IT TO STOP.

App info -> Storage -> Clear data -> Clear cache
App info -> Network access -> turn off Mobile data / WLAN / Background data
[Take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI]
App info -> Power - Battery details -> Battery saver -> Restrict background apps
App info -> Permissions -> Autostart -> OFF
App info -> Permissions -> Permissions -> OFF
[Watch out for the nestedness, turn off all settings and even sub settings, take a note that in some cases it is not possible in user GUI]

Turn off damn notifications!

░▒▓█ UPDATE CAMERA MODULE

On the first screen we need only GetApps application to update Camera and then you can restrict it as a Browser we did earlier. Upon first start untick checkbox Update over WLAN and agree to proceed. In a couple of time application will push refused suggestion again, so repeat denial. Right after that there will be another attempt to push loads of shit to your device [They call it “essential apps”, reject it with a force. After updating camera application remove ALL possible permissions from GetApps bloatfest abomination, especially restrict access to the list of installed applications.

░▒▓█ TURN OFF ADS AND USAGE TELEMETRY

Privacy & security -> Security -> Additional settings -> Usage and diagnostics -> OFF
Important: type in settings search Ads and select Manage system ads > Ads in system apps > OFF

░▒▓█ TURN OFF FAKE MEMORY EXTENDER

Do this to get rid of stutters and micro freezes.

Ok back to those green shield (shit). In settings:

Take away all possible permissions and notifications, because it is super annoying thing. As for me i just “uninstalled” that sucker. But it can’t be fully uninstalled since we don’t have root. More over this shit will try to restore it in a while, so pay attention.

[Install F-Droid] to get the reliable source of free applications.

Get rid of embedded bloated Chinese keyboard and replace it with [Unexpected Keyboard] . Make sure to turn off native keyboards Baido IME and Sogou IME, they can be found in.

Settings -> Additional settings -> Accounts & sync -> Basic Google Services -> ON

You can install latest Google Play from the [APkpure] if you want to be “UP-TO-DATE”.

░▒▓█ OVERCOME SHIT STORM OF BLOATWARE PISS

In this part we will tune system to our own preferences and continue to fight with pre-installed bloatware.

When you try to install any application from [F-Droid] you will be faced this hieroglyphs.

Select right button to proceed. Later we’ll deal with it harshly. Right after that system spits at you with next vomit like this. Reject with a force.

System will try to install Security green shield when you enter installed Apps menu. Reject the action.

Settings -> Apps -> ... -> Show all apps
This is the place for all your apps to handle.

Settings -> Apps -> Autostart
Set to autostart here your Launcher, keyboard and camera application.
Remember that three dots holds Show system apps.
Remove all cr#p like AI and hieroglyphic applications to speed up system boot.

If you are installing third party launcher make sure to restrict System Launcher as much as possible. You will be shown a scary red danger sign with red buttons. Third party is way good especially abandoned ones.

Don’t forget to take away Mobile data and Background data permissions from Package installer, just to minimize network queries, although WiFi traffic can’t be turned of from GUI.

You can lock applications in recent list by swiping from top to the bottom in the recent applications gallery you will see a little lock next to application name if it is protected.

░▒▓█ RESTRICTING NETWORK ACCESS
